gate: ADR-019 item 6 (Council Ruling 002 tripwire (a)) -- the booking gate

sensor.image_size_cross_check: live 640x480 == config 640x480; a mismatch is a REFUSAL (the world SDF is generated from that config, so it means the wrong camera was read)
sensor.clip_far_corner_rule: |ray| = sqrt(1 + (max(cx, W-1-cx)/fx)^2 + (max(cy, H-1-cy)/fy)^2) -- the FARTHEST corner from the principal point, the first pixel gz culls
sensor.clip_semantics: value = pinhole Z-depth; the NEAR cull is on Z-depth, the FAR cull on EUCLIDEAN slant range (gz-rendering8 depth_camera_fs.glsl), so the effective Z horizon shrinks by |ray| off-axis
sensor.acquisition_clamp_note: no optical prefix was given (or it equals the booked range), so this run records no clamp. An unclamped LIVE acquisition range should equal D3's prefix; if D3 clamped and the prefix is not passed here, the artifact cannot say so

encounter.bird_speed_source: max over farm_world_birds.json (check_live_flight_log.max_bird_speed_m_s -- the fastest bird, not today's threat)

plant.name: guided_default
plant.mission_speed_cap_is_checked: escape_survives_mission_speed_cap in `checks` -- the margin bar re-run against the capped plant (G127); these two numbers are no longer decoration

budget.escape_at_available_lead_note: the bar restated in metres. ALGEBRAICALLY IMPLIED by `margin` (same plant, same numbers) -- not a check and not a cross-check; see the comment above the checks list.
budget.unmodelled: AUTO->GUIDED mode-switch latency (TG-5) is NOT in this budget and is unmeasured; every eval/point_mass omission (attitude lag, motor lag, EKF lag, wind/drag) makes the plant OPTIMISTIC. The margin is an upper bound on safety, never a promise.

checks.name: band_in_frame_at_acquisition
checks.detail: the +/-6 m threat band is in frame from 13.05 m, acquisition is at 46.00 m

checks.name: acquisition_within_corner_far_clip
checks.detail: acquisition 46.00 m vs the 47.56 m Z-depth horizon at the FARTHEST FRAME CORNER, pixel (0, 0) = (320, 240) px off the principal point of a 640x480 frame (far clip 60 m culled on Euclidean slant range, |ray| 1.262x on-axis). Headroom 3.4 % -- NOT the 30 % the on-axis clip suggests

checks.name: escape_survives_mission_speed_cap
checks.detail: a 4 m/s cap does not bind: the 3.00 m escape never reaches the velocity limit, t_req is 1.792 s either way and the cap-honest margin 1.942x IS the headline margin -- checked, not assumed
